title: Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (experimental v2)
description: Clinician-administered recent suicidal ideation (past month), levels 1-5. Each item is yes, no, or unknown. Severity is the highest level answered yes, otherwise 0. Unknown is an explicit answer, not a negative and not unanswered. No composite score.

items.prompt: Ideation 1 (Wish to be dead, recent): Have you wished you were dead, or wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
Ideation 2 (Nonspecific active thoughts, recent): Have you had thoughts of killing yourself, without thinking about a method, intent, or plan?
Ideation 3 (Method, without intent, recent): Have you thought about how you might kill yourself, without intending to act on those thoughts?
Ideation 4 (Some intent, no specific plan, recent): Have you had suicidal thoughts and some intention of acting on them, but without a specific plan?
Ideation 5 (Specific plan and intent, recent): Have you worked out a method or plan for killing yourself, and do you intend to carry it out?

source.note: Live instrument is recent ideation levels 1-5 only (past month). Intensity, behavior, lethality, and lifetime items are not part of this version.

assumptions: Ideation item wording is a concise paraphrase of the source table; the authorized form governs exact administration wording and probes.
The live instrument asks only recent ideation levels 1-5 (past month). Each answer is yes, no, or unknown.
Unknown is an explicit answer. It is not a negative and it is not unanswered. A draft with no saved answers is the five unknown answers.
A yes to a higher ideation level does not fill lower levels.
Severity is the highest level answered yes, otherwise 0. There is no composite score.
high_risk_alert applies only when that severity is 4 or 5. clinical_review applies when any level is yes. no_positive_items applies only when all five are no.
This version records no new clinical approval. The hash-pinned v1 file is unchanged and is not the live instrument.
experimental_defaults: Form choice: five recent ideation items only. Lifetime ideation, intensity, behavior, and lethality are not collected.
Time window: recent ideation = past_month. The section label is Recent ideation — past month.
No branching skips: all five levels are asked explicitly and a higher-level yes never fills in lower levels.
An absent recent answer is unknown, except when the section is skipped.
Immediate emergency concern (current intent/plan, attempt in progress, inability to stay safe) is clinician-determined and is never a calculated flag.
source_gaps: The supplied source does not contain the authorized exact administration wording/probes; paraphrase status is preserved.
The source gives no composite or cutoff; none is defined here.
Behavior, intensity, lethality, and lifetime sections of the source are outside this live instrument.

validation_results.notes: v1 reference examples do not define this five-item instrument. No new clinical approval is claimed.

release.disclaimer: Experimental assessment package. This does NOT establish clinical validation, records no new clinical approval, and introduces no treatment thresholds.
release.release_notes: Live C-SSRS is the five recent-ideation items (yes/no/unknown). Retired sections are not scored. No new clinical approval.
